$77K last week from one buyer. Not one product. One buyer. Women 45-65. She holds half the money in America. She doesn't check Temu. She doesn't return. She buys 2 and tells her sister. Everything I sell is for her and I've never run an ad to anyone under 35. Men 18-34 price compare, return 7x more, and tell nobody

I put the full one-buyer system into a 36-page guide:

> why you pick the person before the product (the product changes every month, the buyer never does)
> why women 45-65 convert at 9-11pm on Facebook and nowhere else (she's in bed, the house is quiet, the card is on the nightstand)
> the 5 product categories she buys on autopilot (things that run out, things for the dog, things for her husband, things for her face, things for the house)
> why "2 for $79" beats "30% off" with her every time (she's buying for two people anyway, the discount makes her suspicious)
> why she never unchecks the subscription box (35-40% keep it, the product does the retention)
> how one buyer becomes 20 products, 4 countries, and $60K a month (same woman in Ohio, Manchester, Munich and Sydney)

→ the 36-page $0-$10K/mo ecom playbook

→ the full video walkthrough - finding products, building pages, launching ads, going live

免费分享这个我会后悔的……

上周从一个买家那里赚了 $77K。不是一个产品。是一个买家。45-65 岁的女性。她掌握着美国一半的钱。她不会查 Temu。她不会退货。她会买 2 件，然后告诉她姐姐/妹妹。我卖的所有东西都是给她的，而且我从来没有向 35 岁以下的人投过广告。18-34 岁的男性会比价，退货多 7 倍，而且不会告诉任何人。

我把完整的单一买家系统写进了一份 36 页的指南：

> 为什么你要先选人，再选产品（产品每个月都在变，买家永远不变）
> 为什么 45-65 岁女性会在晚上 9-11 点在 Facebook 上转化，而不是在其他地方（她在床上，家里很安静，卡就在床头柜上）
> 她会自动购买的 5 个产品类别（会用完的东西、给狗的东西、给她丈夫的东西、给她脸的东西、给家里的东西）
> 为什么“2 件 $79”每次都比“30% off”更能打动她（反正她本来就是给两个人买，折扣会让她起疑）
> 为什么她从来不会取消勾选订阅框（35-40% 会保留，产品本身负责留存）
> 一个买家如何变成 20 个产品、4 个国家和每月 $60K（俄亥俄、曼彻斯特、慕尼黑和悉尼的同一个女人）

→ 36 页的 $0-$10K/月电商玩法手册
→ 6 点产品页面检查清单，把 CVR 从 1.2% → 3.4%
→ 完整视频讲解——找产品、搭建页面、投放广告、上线
